    Weekly crypto market report

    How this report is made

    Every Monday the site's data refresh downloads a year of daily closing prices (UTC) for each coin from Binance, Kraken or Coinbase and rebuilds this page from them. Changes compare the latest daily close with the close seven days earlier. Stablecoins are left out of the counts, the medians and the tables because they barely move. The report contains only these measured figures: no headlines, forecasts or opinions. Sources and methods are on the About page; the heatmap shows the market live.

    Not financial advice. Prices come from public exchange data and may be delayed or inaccurate.
